survey: A gold three-branch candelabra, seen from the front and a little above. A round domed foot sits flat on the ground, and its rim is an open ellipse viewed from above. A turned central column rises straight up from the foot through a knop and a collar. Two U-shaped arms come out of the collar, one on each side. They curve down, then up, lie in the same plane as the picture, and mirror each other. Each arm ends in a drip-pan cup, and the column ends in a third cup. Each cup holds an upright cream candle with a flame. The cup ellipses get narrower going up the object: the foot is the most open, the side cups are narrower, and the candle tops are almost edge-on. That fits a single camera with its eye level near the candle tops. All the verticals are vertical, the candles sit straight and parallel in their cups, and the foot rests flat on the ground.
